column1: # Toponyms and given names with distinct Taraškievica forms.
# Names that differ only by a regular rule (Свіцязь → Сьвіцязь, Еўропа → Эўропа) are not listed.
# §17 ("у форме безь й … паасобныя ўсходнехрысьціянскія імёны: Валеры, Георгі, Дзьмітры, …, Юры"):
# the base forms. The adapted forms Зьміцер, Валер (§17) and Павал (§55.1 Заўвага А) are also
# valid, so they are not substituted (NORMS.md, optional forms). Леанід stays (§48 "Але: Леанід").
# --- Швейцарыя → Швайцарыя: stem swap only, endings unchanged.
# Forms: GrammarDB RELEASE-202601, paradigms Швейцарыя (NPIINF2) and швейцарскі (ARP).
# Only these exact forms; швейцар (doorman) is a different lexeme and is not touched.
# --- Country names in all case forms. Forms: GrammarDB RELEASE-202601 paradigms (NPIINF2 /
# NPIINM1); Taraškievica targets checked against the project owner's reference list and
# baltoslav.eu (spot-check only). Same paradigm on both sides, so only the stem changes.
# Sources for the stems: Аргентына §66, Армэнія §11, Гішпанія §33 §64, Расея §33 (Збор 2005);
# Бэльгія, Мэксыка, Кыргыстан are not in the rules text (owner's list).
# Германія → Нямеччына (Збор 2005 §37): endings differ by case. Германіі is genitive, dative and
# locative at once, so it is chosen by context in data/lexicon/case/ambiguous.tsv; only the
# reverse keys (Нямеччыны, Нямеччыне → Германіі) are listed here, one-way.
